main.description: Moderates a member's participation in a voice channel: server-mute, server-deafen, or force-disconnect. Requires the `voice.moderate` community permission and the caller must outrank the target. Server-mute/deafen are enforced by the SFU and persist for the room's lifetime, disconnect is transient (the target may rejoin).

community.description: AT-URI of the community the channel belongs to.

target.description: DID of the member to moderate.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: Missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller lacks the permission this method requires.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A parameter or body field was missing or malformed.
